entities.name: Ivan Ivanišević
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ivan Ivanišević is a Serbian chess player who received the FIDE title of Grandmaster in 2000. He won the Serbian Chess Championship in 2008, 2009, 2011, 2012, 2017, 2019 and 2025. He participated in seven Chess Olympiads to date, representing FR Yugoslavia and Serbia, three times on the first board.
